name: vscode-theme-zellner-extended
description: Extended light and dark variants of the Zellner color theme for Visual Studio Code
author: Yue Yu

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/expand-theme.js ../../schemes/zellner-bright.scheme.json themes/zellner-bright-color-theme.json && node ../../scripts/expand-theme.js ../../schemes/zellner-bright.dark.scheme.json themes/zellner-bright-dark-color-theme.json && node ../../scripts/expand-theme.js ../../schemes/zellner-bright-magenta.scheme.json themes/zellner-bright-magenta-color-theme.json && node ../../scripts/expand-theme.js ../../schemes/zellner-bright-magenta.dark.scheme.json themes/zellner-bright-magenta-dark-color-theme.json && node ../../scripts/expand-theme.js ../../schemes/zellner-soft.scheme.json themes/zellner-soft-color-theme.json && node ../../scripts/expand-theme.js ../../schemes/zellner-soft.dark.scheme.json themes/zellner-soft-dark-color-theme.json && node ../../scripts/expand-theme.js ../../schemes/zellner-pastel.scheme.json themes/zellner-pastel-color-theme.json && node ../../scripts/expand-theme.js ../../schemes/zellner-pastel.dark.scheme.json themes/zellner-pastel-dark-color-theme.json
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce package --baseContentUrl https://github.com/yuyuqp/zellner/blob/main/packages/vscode-extended --baseImagesUrl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuyuqp/zellner/main/packages/vscode-extended
scripts.publish:vsce: pnpm run build && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce publish --baseContentUrl https://github.com/yuyuqp/zellner/blob/main/packages/vscode-extended --baseImagesUrl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuyuqp/zellner/main/packages/vscode-extended
scripts.publish:ovsx: pnpm run package && pnpm dlx ovsx publish vscode-theme-zellner-extended-0.2.0.vsix
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); pkg.contributes.themes.forEach(theme => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(theme.path, 'utf8'))); console.log('Extended VS Code theme JSON is valid');"
